translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: O KEBU, ni dindingac amma ebicfu kecma yoac deduae, imocac yoacna negenna. Ni arohoma kpacguba ge yoacna negenna. Enacbibicna ikoha kpacngo numugemba ge kedzac kpema nunumuna negenna.
Ge yoacfu neac yoac faka dindingac modacma forana debesena nga geac kicngo faka dindingac hembeso.
Foracngoc, ge tofonac yugucnuma tobangge herena hennegeng annadeu nearu mangana mong mi meficgenade. Enacnango yoac kopocsihagoc mong mi debadeac negenseriai.
Ngic goa yeni faka angammemengina hania hania fede, fora. Nga ni sifu enacbibicgango yoac denec, imoc modacma garengemema yarengic yeneac sinnu mong mi kenai.
Ni serima geac sinnu tima kengha amma hanina mong mi tiposockeec.
O Anutu, geng nunumunaac turunga merennennadeac kpacguduae. Ge kedzacga nearu faima yoacna negenna.

Geng yoac dedzege amma imoc modackecnec, wiac imoc bibiagoc andeac imoc edzacnuyombonggena. Ngicngac neni ngabafocnina yenearunac meickema sufunideac geac hoannu hani geng ebicfunac mesinununade. Nga ngaba yenearunac gearu hama marifoigau sufunide.
Ge geangga kicga garenggeannec, ge ifi isoc ni garennuma kpeganggaac debannu fainuma mesufununa.
Ngic goa yeni Anutu ngadehema mangana megecdeac ayemmeu kpetotienubeso andae. Nga ngaba yeni kpebucnugecdeac negemma oronnuma nandae, ge yenearunac mesufununa.
Yeni herengina dzegegec yenearu ubamangang mong mi feyemmeu enacnginango yoackpekpe kpegecde.
Yeni hanina modacma kisannuma meficnuma yaguc oronnuma nandae. Yeni kicngina kucgoc nearu fima bangecfu kpefacnubeso andae.
Raiong yangtoango wiac kisamma sorienacngo sebia merecgeudeac ammiande nga raiong kuhagocngo sufu sufuu ngonducnema tomai feande, yeni ifi isoc andae.
O KEBU, ge yacma kemma ngabafocna kicnginau hama yunuma bangecfu ukuyununa. Ngic Anutu ngadehema mangana megecdeac ayemmeande, yeni menugecac dzikacbeanggango kekecna yeneac mariunac mesina.

O KEBU, ge geangga maringo bangecngic yenearunac mesinuna. Bangecngic yeni bangec yomohai kecma imocac wiac mekpedzuc amma mekecdae, yeni imocac areng. Ge yeneac negemma wiac faina fede, imocngo herengina mewakeude. Mewakeu medacfocngina yeneng wiac imoc monggoc nga monggoc mekecma nambaracfocngina yeneac negemma noboha faigec tarude.
Anu ni dindingac kecma kicmesuga hemma gauunac gborima geac kicsiric hemba gunucnude.
